title: Majestic Victory
reviewNotes: Three branches, 20 exact positions from the complete four-piece root. c7 and the selected descending king walk answer the repeated rook checks; Kc2 avoids the lower-rank skewer. After ...Rd4, c8=R ...Ra4 Kb3 retains an exact win and threatens Rc1 mate. c8=Q ...Rc4+ Qxc4 is actual stalemate. The independent rook-promotion comparison ...Rc4+ Rxc4 ...Ka2 remains winning and is not stalemate. Final source surrender images are not used to invent a forced continuation.
